page0.text:
The park is empty as usual.
Maybe because it's chillier than usual.
There's hardly anyone out. It looks like I'm the only one walking around right now.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page0:1

page1.text:
...
I slump down onto a bench.
Well, I came here to be alone.
Now that I'm here, I should think of what to do next.
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page1:1

page2.text:
I can't put my decision off any longer.
If I want to defeat the other Masters and end this Holy Grail War, I need Saber.
That's not what this is about though. I just don't want to lose Saber.
But that means...
I'd have to have Saber attack people, like Rider did.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page2:1

page3.text:
"...Hngh."
I can't let her do that.
Giving Saber that order is as good as telling her to die.
Besides, I think she'd just refuse outright.
But...
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page3:1

page4.text:
...when my head slumps down, I see my left hand.
I have two Command Spells left.
If I use one, I can force Saber to obey me even if she refuses.
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page4:1

page5.text:
...
I bite my lip and shake the thought off. It's ridiculous.
Time slips by me as I sit on the bench; I have no idea how long I remain sitting there.
But just as my fingers start to tremble from the cold...
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page5:1

page6.text:
"Ah!!!
I thought I'd never see you again, but you're here!"
I look up, hearing a voice calling to me.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page6:1

page7.text: "Heehee. It really is you. Hello, Shirou. You look down. Did something happen?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page7:1

page8.text:
"Illya? Did you come all the way here by yourself again?
It's not safe. You never know where Masters are lurking—"
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page8:1

page9.text:
...I'm about to warn her that other Masters might be lurking nearby, waiting to attack. I catch myself, realizing how stupid that would be.
Illya's a Master.
I shouldn't be worried about her. We're enemies.
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page9:1

page10.text: "Sorry. I don't really have time to talk right now. I know we bumped into each other, but I can't talk today. It's going to be really cold, so you should head home."
page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page10:1

page11.text:
I don't get up from the bench as I dismiss Illya.
There are plenty of things I'd like to talk to her about, but I can't think of anything other than Saber right now.
page11.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page11:1

page12.text:
...
Hm?
What's going on?
Illya doesn't say anything. She's looking at me as if I'm a stranger.
page12.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page12:1

page13.text:
"Illya?
Sorry. I don't mean to be harsh. I've just...got a lot on my mind right now..."
page13.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page13:1

page14.text:
"I know. Saber's about to disappear, right?
And you're wondering what to do."
Just out of nowhere...
...Illya's voice has gotten so cold and detached.
page14.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page14:1

page15.text:
"Illya?"
"What a stupid thing to worry about. No wonder you let Rider's Master get away. You just need to kill losers like them."
page15.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page15:1

page16.text:
I move my feet.
Something tells me this isn't a time to be sitting, so I shift my weight forward to get up.
But...
My body doesn't move, as if I'm entranced by Illya.
page16.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page16:1

page17.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page17:1

page18.text:
"There's not much to explain. I was there last night, at the building.
I could only watch from inside though."
page18.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page18:1

page19.text:
"Gh—!?"
I try to make my hands and feet move, but nothing happens.
No, it feels like the more I try to move, the stiffer they get.
It's those eyes.
Whenever I see Illya's red eyes, my senses go...dull...
page19.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page19:1

page20.text:
"Oh. You're already chained down.
You really weren't on your guard at all. I thought it'd be easier to capture you if you were all alone, but you're so cute, getting caught so easily."
page20.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page20:1

page21.text:
"Illya, yo...u..."
"It's no use, brother. You can't move now.
Soon, you won't be able to talk. But there's nothing to worry about.
I actually didn't come here to talk today either."
page21.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page21:1

page22.text:
Illya's eyes blaze with murderous intent.
This is Illya as I saw her the other night: Berserker's Master.
page22.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page22:1

page23.text:
"Kngh...! Do you plan to kill me...right here...!?"
I grit my teeth and gather all my strength.
But my fingers won't so much as budge.
It's like Illya's stare has frozen every nerve in my body.
page23.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page23:1

page24.text:
"Yep. There's no reason for you to remain a Master, right? If Saber disappears, you'll be all alone. I can't have you go on being a Master.
I can kill you easily if you have no other means to fight."
page24.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page24:1

page25.text:
Illya raises her hand.
Her slender white fingers reach for my chest.
page25.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page25:1

page26.text:
"I'm glad I found you before the others killed you.
So good night, brother. Saber's going to disappear anyway, so the sooner the better, right?"
page26.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page26:1

page27.text:
My vision fades.
My limbs have gone completely numb, and now I can't see either.
...How long have I been stuck in this darkness?
Before I can figure out whether I'm alive or dead, I lose consciousness.
page27.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page27:1

page28.text:
...My body is burning.
Even if my consciousness has fallen into darkness, the burning in my body tells me I'm still alive.
Yes. That must mean I'm still alive.
Even so, it may only be temporary.
Illya even said it.
page28.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page28:1

page30.text:
...She's absolutely right.
Without Saber, I can't fight a proper battle.
A Holy Grail War is a battle between Servants.
And there's no way I can go up against Servants.
That's been proved more than enough by now.
page30.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page30:1

page31.text:
Each time, I got absolutely thrashed.
Like Saber said, all I can do against Servants is try to survive for as long as possible.
I couldn't even do that.
I was cut to pieces, and even thrown out of a third-story window.
It's only this weird, inexplicable thing going on with my body that's kept me alive.
page31.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page31:1

page32.text:
It's so frustrating... It makes me so, so angry.
In the face of an unbeatable opponent, I couldn't stop the catastrophe in front of me on my own.
Even though I decided to fight.
I said I was going to fight as a Master and vowed to not hurt anyone, but I couldn't even keep those promises.
page32.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page32:1

page33.text:
I'm pissed off.
The champions of justice I strived to emulate when I was young always had to win, or there would be no point.
page33.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page33:1

page34.text:
...My body is burning.
Every inch of me trembles with the need to win.
But I have neither the means to win, or even a way to fight.
What good am I?
I can't even fight alongside Saber without bringing her down.
page34.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page34:1

page35.text:
"Another mistake. You're not fit for fighting, Shirou Emiya.
Your battle is supposed to be a mental one...
...a fight against your own self."
page35.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page35:1

page36.text:
Suddenly...
I remember Archer saying that.
page36.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page36:1

page37.text:
"You haven't got a prayer of winning once the battle starts.
None of your skills...
...are worth a damn against Servants."
page37.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page37:1

page38.text:
I know that.
I've certainly been reminded more than enough.
page38.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page38:1

page39.text:
"Then at least imagine it.
If you can't possibly beat the opponent in reality, then beat them in your imagination.
If you can't win yourself...imagine something that can win."
page39.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page39:1

page40.text:
...You don't have to remind me.
I can only win in my own head.
But what can I imagine that would ever help me win?
I can't imagine beating a Servant.
I don't have such a wild imagination as to fool myself. Any fantasy I come up with will be full of loose threads that'll come unraveled.
My third-rate imagination hasn't got a prayer against these incredible Servants.
page40.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page40:1

page41.text:
That's why...
Who do I win against...
And how do I win?
I'm still searching for that answer...
page41.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page41:1

page42.text:
Am I really searching for it?
That golden sword.
It's meant only for her.
I don't want it for myself...
It's just... It's so beautiful.
Just once, I'd like to hold it in my hands if I can.
page42.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page42:1

page43.text:
...Ugh. I guess this is just a bad habit I've picked up as an untrained mage.
Since all I can do is look within myself, I tend to dream about stuff I shouldn't.
I should at least be allowed to dream.
page43.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page43:1

page44.text:
First, I imagine the thing's basic structure, then reproduce it.
...Heh. I guess there's not much point in Strengthening here.
If Strengthening is the act of applying something to an existing object, there's not much point in doing that to something that doesn't even exist.
That means I need to work harder if I'm going to remember that sword.
page44.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page44:1

page45.text:
This is well before the basics.
This is from before Kiritsugu taught me Strengthening...a magecraft process that I thought up on my own, and packed with trivial steps.
page45.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page45:1

page46.text: Let's see... How did I do it? How did I give it form...?
page46.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page46:1

page47.text: ...When I come to, I have no idea where I am.
page47.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page47:1

page48.text:
"Where...am I...?"
This place isn't just unfamiliar.
There's a luxurious canopy bed, and the plush carpet is ankle-deep.
There's even a stone fireplace, and it's clearly not just a decoration.
page48.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page48:1

page49.text:
What I initially take for wallpaper I realize, on inspection, is actually patterns engraved on the wall.
I've gotten used to fancy decorations like the ones in Shinji's mansion, but this is something else entirely.
It's a little embarrassing to say this out loud, but this place is like a castle from a fairy tale.
page49.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page49:1

page50.text:
"...Ngh."
My vision blurs.
My body feels strangely heavy.
Maybe I'm having circulation problems or something? I feel like I might fall back asleep if I relax even a little.
page50.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page50:1

page51.text:
"Um...what the hell happened?"
I try to get my clouded mind working.
I was...oh right. Illya paralyzed me and I just passed out.
page51.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page51:1

page52.text:
"So, Illya's captured me..."
There's nobody in the room.
My body feels heavy, but not so bad that I can't even lift a finger like before.
If I really work at it, I might be able to lift an arm.
page52.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page52:1

page53.text:
"What the...!? I'm tied up!"
My drowsy mind suddenly jolts to full alertness.
I realize I'm in danger, and so study my surroundings carefully.
page53.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page53:1

page54.text:
"I'm in a chair. My hands are bound behind my back. I'm handcuffed... No. My wrists are just tied with rope."
It's not as bad as I imagined, but I still can't move.
My whole body is weirdly...tingly, and I can't get up with my arms tied behind me.
page54.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page54:1

page55.text:
"I wonder how long I've been here. Is there a... No, no clock here."
There's nothing in here to tell me what time it is.
A window... There's a window behind me.
I try to turn and get a look, but the curtains are closed, so I can't see outside.
All I can say for sure is that the sun's set.
I ran into Illya in the morning, so it's been at least half a day.
page55.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page55:1

page56.text:
"..."
I don't have time for this.
I have no idea where I am, but I need to get back to Saber as fast as I can.
...Saber's in a weakened state.
I can't be even more of a burden to her by letting something like this happen!
page56.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page56:1

page57.text:
"Hngh!"
I try to make my arms move.
If I'm going to escape, I have to do something about these ropes around my wrists.
page57.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page57:1

page58.text:
"Ah!?"
The door opens.
I go still just as Illya enters the room.
page58.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page58:1

page59.text:
"Oh, you finally woke up! Morning, brother! How are you feeling?"
Illya's not acting at all like she had earlier.
The coldness in her eyes is gone, and she's back to acting like the cheerful girl she'd been at the park the other day.
page59.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page59:1

page60.text:
"Hm? What's wrong? You don't look so good. You still can't move? That's weird. You should at least be able to talk by now."
Illya peers into my face, looking puzzled.
She seems genuinely concerned for me.
page60.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page60:1

page61.text: "I'm fine. I can talk, and my mind's clear enough to understand that I've been captured."
page61.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page61:1

page62.text:
"Oh, are you complaining? Did you know prisoners are usually supposed to go into the basement cell?"
But I felt bad at the thought of doing that to you, so I brought you to my room."
I don't know if that's good or bad.
But at least I understand what's going on a little better.
page62.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page62:1

page63.text:
"I'm getting a clearer picture of what happened. I've been captured, and this is where you live."
I speak flatly, trying to kill my emotions.
Until I understand completely what's happening here, I just need to listen.
page63.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page63:1

page64.text: "That's right. Remember I told you I live in a castle in a forest?"
page64.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page64:1

page65.text: "This is a castle in the middle of a biiig forest. There's nothing else around. It takes a few hours by car just to get to your city. There's no chance of a rescue out here, and nobody will come bother us either."
page65.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page65:1

page66.text:
"I see.
Okay, but why did you do this?
If you were going to kill me, you could've done it at the park."
page66.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page66:1

page67.text:
"Why would I? I don't intend to kill you. You're mine. I'll kill the other Masters, but you're special.
I locked you up here so that nobody could bother us."
page67.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page67:1

page68.text:
"Gh—!?"
I find myself recoiling.
Illya pushes her face closer to me, ignoring my agitation.
page68.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page68:1

page69.text:
"I-Illya...what are you...!?"
I-I know it's inappropriate, but the way Illya sits on my lap has my heart racing.
She may not be heavy, but the way she's sitting on my lap has me thinking...kinda graphic thoughts.
page69.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page69:1

page70.text:
"Yep. I knew it. You're special, Shirou.
Hey. Want to be my Servant? If you say you'll be my Servant, I won't kill you. If you just nod, I'll spare you."
page70.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page70:1

page71.text:
Illya's words are so pure and heartfelt, I know that if I nod even once, it'll be a choice I can't unmake...and I will absolutely come to regret it.
...On the other hand, if I refuse, that purity will turn into pure wickedness.
page71.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page71:1

page72.text:
With Illya leaning so close, my mind grinds to a shrieking halt.
She's not saying this just because she likes me.
This is more like an interrogation, a matter of whether I want to live or die.
page72.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page72:1

page73.text:
"This is a no-brainer. You don't have Saber anymore. You don't have a way of fighting.
That means there's no reason for you to remain a Master."
page73.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page73:1

page74.text: "No. Saber hasn't disappeared yet. And I'm not going to let it happen."
page74.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page74:1

page75.text:
"Oh really? But it would be so easy to kill you in your state.
Just give in and stay here. If you stay by my side forever, I'll protect you forever."
page75.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page75:1

page76.text:
Illya presses close against me.
...I'm not sure what'll happen if I refuse.
But I still can't agree.
page76.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page76:1

page77.text:
"I can't. Step away, Illya. No matter what you say, I..."
Illya presses her index finger to my lips.
She giggles in amusement and watches me in my bewilderment.
page77.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page77:1

page78.text:
"You really don't understand.
Listen. You're like a bird in a cage. It's my decision whether to keep you alive or kill you. You shouldn't say anything that might make me mad.
I've waited ten years for this. Killing you quickly would just be boring."
page78.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page78:1

page79.text:
"Wha—"
Illya talks like she's asking for a toy.
The sheer cold-heartedness in her voice sends a shiver down my spine.
page79.sourceUnit: セイバールート十一日目-16:page79:1
